quirks: Nested iframes: the working UI is in interface/main/tabs/main.php; each open tab is a child frame. Use frame-scoped selectors (e.g. --frame dynamic_finder).

Top nav tabs have hidden template SPANs (class tabHidden) behind the fixed navbar — a role/text click can resolve to the hidden one and report occlusion. Act on the visible tab strip or navigate the child frame directly.
Reads via POST: summary panels and finder are POSTs that return HTML/JSON and change no state — pre-mark them read (known_read_post_families) or the write-flag over-fires.
controller.php returns 403 for the physician role — a real permission boundary, fires the error sentinel (not a bug).
Chart-open shows a native alert (auto-accepted per dialog policy) when the patient has due clinical reminders.
selector_strategy: Stable ids exist for form controls (#authUser, #clearPass, #login-button) and app landmarks; patient rows carry DT_RowId='pid_<N>'. Prefer ids and role/text; frame-scope everything inside a tab.
